author: Jarrod Wardwell
title: Who is D4vd? Police suspect Houston-raised music star in death of 15-year-old girl - NewsBreak
text:
By Jarrod Wardwell ,
9 hours ago Singer D4vd performs onstage during Day 1 of Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival on April 18, 2025 in Indio, California. (Scott Dudelson/Getty Images for Coachella) Houston-raised singer D4vd was around a month into his first world tour when Los Angeles police found the dismembered body of a teenage girl inside his abandoned Tesla in September.
The discovery launched an investigation into the death of 15-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez, and D4vd, 20, whose given name is David Anthony Burke, is now a named suspect. D4vd canceled the rest of his U.S. shows amid the police investigation, which has not led to any arrests, according to reports.
The case has been an unexpected turn in the young star's career, which took off from Houston roughly three years ago. Here is D4vd's backstory, from his local ties to the ongoing investigation:
Roots in Texas D4vd was born in Queens, N.Y. before moving to Houston as a young teenager, according to a feature in Billboard . A GQ profile in 2023 stated he would record songs in his family's Houston area home , tucked inside his six-year-old sister's closet.
Burke made Fortnite montage videos on YouTube with music from other artists, but he started making his own music to avoid copyright strikes on the content. After his songs went viral, his manager flew to Houston to discuss the music industry , according to the Billboard feature.
The two met inside a local Panera Bread, the story states.
Deputies responded to D4vd's Cypress home a little more than a week after Hernandez's body was found in his Tesla, but they had received a fake swatting call falsely reporting a dead female victim, according to ABC7 in Los Angeles. D4vd's parents live at the home, and the artist transferred the property to his mother nearly a week after the law enforcement response, the outlet reported.
How did D4vd become famous? D4vd's music blew up in 2022 as his hits "Romantic Homicide" and "Here With Me" went viral on TikTok. Each track has since accumulated over 1.5 billion streams on Spotify.
Billboard reported he signed with Darkroom and Interscope Records that year and released an EP titled "Petals to Thorns" in 2023. D4vd has amassed nearly 4 million followers on TikTok and more than 25 million monthly listeners on Spotify.
His first album "WITHERED" dropped earlier this year, and he embarked on his first world tour in April, kicking off nearly 30 North America shows before a later trip planned in Europe. In early September, he released Fortnite's first official anthem called "Locked & Loaded."
About two weeks later, his remaining U.S. tour dates were canceled amid the Los Angeles police investigation .
When did D4vd perform in Houston? The Houston-raised star has returned to his hometown multiple times to perform at White Oak Music Hall since his breakout, according to past local news reports .
His most recent show there came in April as he introduced the "WITHERED" album .
He also planned to host a toy drive there for children in foster homes before Christmas last year.
Investigation in Los Angeles Celeste's body was found in the front trunk of D4vd's Tesla at a Hollywood tow yard on Sept. 8 after a caller said an odor was coming from the vehicle. The vehicle had reportedly been sitting in Hollywood Hills for over a month, and it reached the tow yard after someone reported it abandoned, according to NBC4 Los Angeles.
Celeste was reported missing early last year , according to ABC7. She called home that May and was never heard from again.
Investigators said D4vd is not cooperating with the investigation, and detectives executed a search warrant at his former West Hollywood Hills home in mid-September, according to ABC. They reportedly confiscated evidence including a computer.
Investigators believe the death is a murder that occurred earlier this year, but the medical examiner has yet to establish a cause of death, according to ABC. Police said D4vd likely had help dismembering and disposing body, according to NBC.
The investigation is still ongoing.
